mission: Mission 3DC - PopSign fresh5 invocation/output guard fix

head.subject: observer: REDIRECT - popsign fresh5 invocation guard fix

changed_files.change_summary: Allows the PopSign fresh5 smoke mode to dry-run the scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1 scaffold, adds the fresh ignored M3DC output directory to the smoke output policy, and keeps final/promoted architecture gates unchanged.
Records the M3DC no-training invocation/output guard fix evidence, dry-run results, negative authorizations, fail-closed proof, and exactly one next action.

source_supported_observations.observation: Mission 3DC authorizes a bounded local/no-spend, no-training invocation/output guard fix only; it does not authorize fitting, Brev, export, browser activation, claim changes, source/register mutation, manifest mutation, tensor mutation, or final-gate changes.

The required repair is to make the PopSign fresh5 --popsign-fresh5-training-smoke --dry-run --check-files surface accept scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1 and output/m3dc-popsign-fresh5-scratch-motion-region-token-temporal-local-fit while preserving old M3CF/M3CR dry-run compatibility and final/promoted-training guards.

M3DB recorded two blockers: the PopSign fresh5 smoke guard rejected scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1, and the output policy rejected output/m3dc-popsign-fresh5-scratch-motion-region-token-temporal-local-fit.

M3DA registered scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1, recorded B=1/B=2 no-grad shape checks with logits B,5, exposed required diagnostics, measured parameter_count 295950, and kept browser claims fail-closed.
Before this repair, POPSIGN_FRESH5_TRAINING_SMOKE_OUTPUT_DIR_RELATIVES listed only the M3CF and M3CR output directories.
Before this repair, the PopSign fresh5 training-smoke invocation guard required args.architecture to equal scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1.
After this repair, the PopSign fresh5 training-smoke invocation guard allows scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1 and scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1.

scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1 remains absent from FINAL_MODEL_ARCHITECTURES; final, lesson milestone, reduced real-data, and controlled clip-heldout architecture guards remain stricter than the PopSign smoke mode.

reviewer_inference: The M3DB invocation/output blockers are resolved for the training dry-run surface because the new scaffold architecture and fresh ignored output directory now preflight successfully.
The repair does not make the scaffold final-ready or browser-ready; it only makes a later bounded local/no-spend fit prompt technically invokable after observer handoff.

No evaluation invocation blocker is visible from this no-training slice: evaluate_rawframe_model.py uses checkpoint_architecture through the shared allowed architecture surface and already supports PopSign fresh5 smoke axis preservation, but no checkpoint exists yet to execute an end-to-end evaluation.
Because the prompt required a no-training guard repair and the required dry-runs pass, the next prompt can draft exactly one bounded local/no-spend fit attempt without Brev.
